answer.worked:
Precision: $0.1\text{ m}$.

Using $A=\pi r^2$ and $r=d/2$:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{lower}}&=\pi\left(\frac{28.55}{2}\right)^2\\A_{\text{lower}}&\approx640.18\text{ m}^2\\A_{\text{upper}}&=\pi\left(\frac{28.65}{2}\right)^2\\A_{\text{upper}}&\approx644.72\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
